answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through hardware remote attestation, confining agents to certified secure enclaves. A validator reef verifies cryptographic proofs rooted in each chip's hardened walnut core. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of procuring physical silicon per identity rather than spinning up synthetic nodes across a velvet software fabric. However, this scheme relies on trusted chip foundries and cannot prevent physical side-channel exploits.
